messages:
maria-ops: Heads up — scheduling a rolling canary + capacity surge tonight 00:30–02:00 UTC for apac-edge racks. We'll cordon 3 racks, reboot nodes, and reseed KV cache. Expect short p95 tail spikes and ~10% drop in burst capacity. Posting plan below.

leo-infra: ack. which racks exactly? can we avoid the eu pools?

maria-ops: racks apac-edge-rack-07/08/09. We will not touch eu pools — routing policy will steer traffic to eu/us as needed.

josh-sre: tagging @ops-oncall — oncall runbook for cordon/reboot is ops/runbooks/node-drain.md. I'll be on-call during the window.

ops-oncall: on it. I'll monitor p95 latency, queue depth, and capacity pressure. Slack alert channel will post metrics.

anya-mlops: do we have a canary model pinned for this? want to ensure KV cache warm path is tested after reseed.

maria-ops: yes — canary model = gptx-3-small:canary-2026-03. Workflow: cordon -> drain -> reboot -> kvseed -> run canary traffic (10% traffic to canary for 10m) -> uncordon.

leo-infra: backfill plan? any reserved capacity we can spin up to reduce impact?

maria-ops: we'll spin a 2-GPU burst fleet (dedicated-burst-temp) for the window. Cost impact estimate ~+$420 for the 90m window. I'll post the cost ticket.

deploy-bot: Maintenance ticket created: INC-2026-1834. Scheduled 00:30–02:00 UTC.

josh-sre: quick preflight checklist: 1) confirm KV seed script in CI (yes) 2) canary config in routing (yes) 3) alert thresholds set (p95>400ms, cpu>85%) 4) notify customers if sustained degradation >10m.

maria-ops: done on checklist. posting commands we'll run:
```
# cordon nodes in rack
infractl cordon --rack apac-edge-rack-07
infractl drain --rack apac-edge-rack-07 --grace 120
# after reboot
infractl kvseed --rack apac-edge-rack-07 --primer canary
```

leo-infra: +1. make sure we have a quick rollback: if p95 > 600ms for 15m, we abort and reroute fully to eu/us and spin additional burst.

ops-oncall: I'll keep the incident channel open and post snapshots every 10m.

anya-mlops: I'll run a small eval suite after canary traffic to verify generation quality and latency regressions.

maria-ops: Thanks all. Will send customer-facing blurb in #support in 30m and add a short note to status.redwood.ai if anything prolonged. :thumbsup:

leo-infra: good luck — ping if you need an extra pair of hands.

josh-sre: see you all at 00:20 UTC for preflight.

deploy-bot: Reminder scheduled: 00:20 UTC preflight check.
